title: Assignments on free coordinates
statement: For a nonnegative integer $n$ and a set $P$ of coordinates in $[n]=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, a free-coordinate assignment is a function that assigns a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each coordinate in $[n]\setminus P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a set of coordinates in $[n]$
